findings.issue: Producer contract typed but invariants (id, order, helper-capture rule) written twice (producer generates, sc-jev-check validates) with no shared code; copies disagree: producer filters name.starts_with('_') (names stored without '@'), consumer rejects only starts_with("@_") so a leaked helper '_fn' passes; docs say '@_'. A second producer writes the algorithm a third time.
options: A (rec): SubjectsDocument::validate + id-assigning builder in sc-agent-types; both sides share; fix helper rule to one spelling in code and docs
B: keep validation in sc-jev-check; sc-treesitter dev-depends for golden tests (breaks no-jev-dep boundary test)
C: JSON Schema for sc/subjects/1 (cannot express id suffix/sort)

findings.issue: Live producer via kind=command does not work in Phase A: check.toml cannot supply {path}; consumer drops producer's typed stderr JevError (reports EXTRACTION_FAILED exit 2, losing EXTRACTION_PARSE_ERROR line, LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE). Only tested e2e route is committed subjects.json.
options: A (rec): optional path on InputSpec::Command substituted for {path} + CommandExtractor parses a single ScAgentErrorResponse stderr line and re-raises the code; add workspace e2e test running real sc-treesitter through check.toml
B: drop {path}; stderr human-only
C: artifact-only in Phase A; remove command until Phase B

findings.issue: Producer errors are JevError variants tied to sc-treesitter by name/hint; enum not #[non_exhaustive] so a second producer's variant is semver-major on published sc-agent-types; sc-treesitter bends variants (missing CLI path -> InputMissing with check.toml hint; u32 overflow -> InputTooLarge; stdout write + git spawn -> ExtractionFailed).
options: A (rec): producer-neutral variants (LanguageUnavailable{producer,language}) + #[non_exhaustive] before first publish; routine: fix misused variants in sc-treesitter
B: separate ProducerError enum wrapped into JevError
C: per-producer variants, edit central enum each time

findings.issue: Second weaker copy of sc-jev-check read.rs: no --end-of-options (option injection via --rev=...); bytes from git show and sha from separate rev-parse (race); sha.len()!=40 rejects SHA-256 repos; errors classified by English stderr text; path rules differ (absolute/backslash accepted here, rejected there).
findings.recommendation: rev-parse --verify --end-of-options <rev>:<path> -> cat-file blob <sha> (atomic, rejects trees); reject leading '-'; accept 40 or 64 hex; LC_ALL=C or exit-code classification; same path rules as read.rs; bead for shared impl.

findings.issue: mimalloc unconditional dep of published library; only the bin installs it.
findings.recommendation: optional dep + default feature cli = [dep:mimalloc] + [[bin]] required-features=[cli].

findings.issue: Lib+bin in one crate; library has no workspace dependents yet is published with wide public API.
options: A (rec): one crate with cli feature + required-features on bin; narrow public API
B: split sc-treesitter lib / sc-treesitter-cli bin
C: bin-only

findings.issue: Grammar feature matrix grows 2^n cfg arms; double lookup; unreachable fallback; never tested except default features (cargo test --no-default-features --features rust fails).
findings.recommendation: One static Grammar table with cfg on elements; cfg-gate per-language tests; cargo hack --each-feature in lint/test.

findings.issue: Dead defensive checks (capture index range, span bounds), repeated UTF-8 validation, full error walk even when root has no error; MISSING nodes not counted as parse errors.
findings.recommendation: &str once; debug_assert the dead checks; skip walk when !has_error(); treat is_missing like is_error.

findings.issue: One file per call/process; Parser and Query rebuilt per call; no match limit or timeout.
options: A (rec): CompiledQuery type + CLI taking several paths emitting array/NDJSON of sc/subjects/1 docs
B: sc/subjects/2 multi-source schema
C: keep one-file-per-process

findings.issue: Published structs ExtractInput/LanguageInfo/QueryInfo have public fields, no #[non_exhaustive]; QueryInfo duplicates private Asset.
findings.recommendation: non_exhaustive; constructor for ExtractInput; QueryInfo from Asset table.

findings.issue: ~170 lines hand-written argv parsing; no --version though shipped via Homebrew/Scoop/WinGet; --help anywhere short-circuits.
findings.recommendation: lexopt/clap with one convention shared with sc-ai, or at least add --version.

findings.issue: Query asset duplicated into fixture tree and kept in sync by a test though query_sha256 already pins it; schema doc grammar_version 0.23.6 vs pinned 0.25.0; boundary conventions differ.
findings.recommendation: Delete fixture copy + test; update doc; one allowed_dependencies convention.

findings.issue: build_request holds the GIL during facade assembly incl. git subprocesses and command extractors (up to 30 s).
findings.recommendation: py.detach(move || build(...)); test that a Python thread progresses during a slow extractor.

findings.issue: sc-observability adapter copied from sc-ai observe.rs and already diverged (fallback action 'event' vs 'session'; log vs try_log; flush errors ignored vs reported); a-8 requires same JSONL shape as CLI.
options: A (rec): small published crate (sc-agent-observe) holding the adapter; roots keep ADR-SAG-0021 path policy; amend ADR-SAG-0016
B: optional observability feature on sc-jev-check (breaks ADR-0013/0016)
C: keep copies + golden JSONL fixture both must match

findings.issue: LoggerGuard decides shutdown in Drop via Arc::strong_count == 1: racy (two last clones dropped concurrently both see 2; shutdown never runs).
findings.recommendation: struct LoggerInner(Logger) with Drop {flush; shutdown}; LoggerGuard holds Arc<LoggerInner>.

findings.issue: Every run_check builds a new Logger/writer on the same JSONL file; live CheckResult/Session keep loggers alive so a long-running Python process accumulates writers.
findings.recommendation: Process-wide OnceLock<Mutex<HashMap<PathBuf, Weak<LoggerInner>>>> keyed by canonical log root (statics fine in a composition root).

findings.issue: Backend-name parsing x3 with different behaviour (py accepts kebab aliases, returns CONFIG_INVALID; sc-ai/sc-jev-check serde snake_case INPUT_INVALID) against ADR-SAG-0001; resolve_repo lacks is_dir check; parse_rev '' -> WORKTREE.
findings.recommendation: impl FromStr for BackendId + RepoRoot::from_optional_dir in sc-agent-types; remove copies; settle the error code.

findings.issue: rlib + pub use of PyO3 wrappers nothing links; run_check signature changes with test-util (non-additive feature); #[allow(too_many_arguments)] x3 without reason.

Non-idiomatic Python API: paths must be str (pathlib rejected); inconsistent return shapes (dict vs CheckResult); getters re-encode JSON per access; CheckResult.ask duplicates Session.ask; pyclasses not frozen; no .pyi/py.typed.
findings.recommendation: Option<PathBuf>; frozen BuiltRequest pyclass; convert outcomes once; #[pyclass(frozen)]; one ask entry; ship stub + py.typed.

findings.issue: Workspace jev_cross_impl test lives in sc-jev-py only for packaging; exercises nothing in the binding; duplicates run.rs:725-737; a-1 canonical-bytes proof now links libpython.
options: A (rec): crates/workspace-tests (publish=false) owning cross-crate proofs incl. the missing e2e producer test
B: sc-agent-types/tests with duplicated fixtures
C: leave; delete the duplicate unit test

findings.issue: Temp-dir helpers re-written per crate; sc-jev-py ones leak on panic.
Binding carries scripted-answer shorthand normalisation + json.dumps conversion though ADR-SAG-0022 says it only forwards (test-only).
findings.recommendation: Move shorthand rule into register_scripted_backends or require object form.

solid: Producer/consumer share one typed contract in sc-agent-types with deny_unknown_fields; sc-jev-check links no parser (ADR-SAG-0015 holds)
sc-treesitter library does no I/O; git confined to bin module; no-jev-dep boundary test
Grammar pins recorded and tested; query bytes hashed

sc-jev-py mostly thin: assembly/runs via sc_jev_check; canonical bytes only from sc_agent_types; no sc-jev dep; never calls resolve_key
test-util gating matches ADR-SAG-0022; GIL released for run_check/ask; one exception class with stable code
